items.html: *There is one correct and true introduction that we have concerning the matter of the ten Sefirot, namely that they contain two aspects: the first is the aspect of the worlds themselves, and this aspect is called the externality of the Sefirot. The second is the aspect of the souls themselves, and this aspect is called the internality of the Sefirot. And you must know that there are three interpretations in the explanation of this introduction.
